canonical_title: HYP_007 — R2 Final Integrity Audit, Test Failure Reconciliation, and Excluded-Session State Lineage Verification

test_failure_reconciliation.root_cause_summary: Windows OS file lock on temporary parquet staging file: pq.read_table(temp_part_path) held an open file handle across os.replace(temp_part_path, target_part_path) in ParquetStorageEngine.write_canonical_part, raising PermissionError [WinError 32].
test_failure_reconciliation.surgical_fix_applied: src/acash/data/storage.py was updated to wrap the verification read in `with pq.ParquetFile(temp_part_path) as reader: staged_table = reader.read(); ...; del staged_table` ensuring explicit handle release prior to os.replace.
test_failure_reconciliation.impact_on_hyp_007_execution: None. The defect was strictly in general parquet storage engine atomic replacement on Windows filesystems.

noise_area_lookback_rule.resolved_lookback_sessions_sequence: 14 valid trading sessions strictly ending on 2023-06-02, skipping 2023-06-05

volatility_daily_close_lineage.authority_reference: Zarattini, Vercruysse, & Fabozzi (2024) and MEC-0017 preregistration: std(spy_return(d-15:d-1)) computes 15-day return volatility from continuous market daily closing series independent of intraday trade participation.

quote_delay_max_outlier_audit.reason_for_delay: Genuine SIP NBBO quoting gap on SPY; Alpaca returned no quotes between 18:30:00Z and 18:31:19Z. Contract FIRST_VALID strictly preserved.
